Name: Nap Time
Author: sonofskywalker3
Description:
[size=5][b]Nap Time[/b][/size]
[b]Nap in your bed to regain energy without ending the day.[/b]
A quick, free way to recover stamina after passing out in the mines or staying up too late — instead of pushing through the day at half energy. PC and Android.

[line]
[size=4][b]What's New in v1.0.1 — Translations[/b][/size]
[b]Nap Time now supports SMAPI's translation system.[/b] All player-facing text (the bed dialogue options and the config labels) can be localized — drop a language file in the i18n folder and it's picked up automatically. Translation pull requests welcome.

[line]
[size=4][b]The problem[/b][/size]
In vanilla Stardew Valley, if you pass out in the mines or stay up too late, you wake up with reduced energy and no free way to get it back — you either spend money, hunt forageables, or push through the day at half stamina. Early game, that really stings.

[line]
[size=4][b]The solution[/b][/size]
Nap Time adds a third option to the bed dialogue: [b]take a nap[/b]. The game fades out, advances time, restores your stamina, and fades back in. No ending the day early — just a quick nap and back to work.

[line]
[size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]
When you interact with your bed while missing energy, a [b]Nap[/b] option appears alongside "Go to bed" and "Cancel":
[quote][b]Nap until 8:20 AM (regain full energy)[/b]
Go to bed for the night
Cancel[/quote][list]
[*]Nap duration is calculated from how much energy you're missing.[/*]
[*]The dialogue tells you exactly when you'll wake up and how much you'll recover.[/*]
[*]If the wake-up time would exceed your configured limit, the nap is capped (partial recovery).[/*]
[*]Works any time of day — after passing out, after heavy mining, whenever.[/*]
[*]If you're already at full energy, the vanilla dialogue appears as normal.[/*]
[/list]At the default 1.0 in-game minute per stamina point: ~70 missing stamina → wake 7:10 AM; ~135 → 8:20 AM; ~270 → 10:30 AM.

[line]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[*](Optional) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game settings (Android players: the [url=https://github.com/sonofskywalker3/GenericModConfigMenu/releases]controller-enabled fork[/url])[/*]
[/list]Works on [b]PC and Android[/b]; compatible with other mods (only patches bed interaction).

[line]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder (so you have [font=Courier New]Mods/NapTime/[/font]).[/*]
[*]Run the game with SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Settings live in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] (created on first run) and can also be edited via GMCM:
[list]
[*][b]Enable Napping[/b] (default on) — show the nap option when interacting with a bed while missing energy.[/*]
[*][b]Minutes Per Stamina[/b] (default 1.0, range 0.1–5.0) — in-game minutes of nap per stamina point. Lower = faster recovery, higher = more punishing.[/*]
[*][b]Latest Wake-Up Time[/b] (default 6:00 PM, range 7:00 AM–midnight) — latest a nap can extend to; beyond it the nap is capped with partial recovery.[/*]
[/list]
